R1.description: retention-cleanup --unattended is refused, with a named cause, nothing written and no engine verb run, unless PolicyState.unattended is set, unattended.cleanup is true and the mode is cleanup or both; --confirm with --unattended and --json without --unattended are refused; --confirm is not required with --unattended

R2.description: Every existing preflight, the oldest-first selection, the cap of 5, the tracked-folder skip, the per-item policy re-read and the first-failure stop are kept; the Manager-side keep_recent skips the newest finished items; the unattended plan equals the preview plan with the same digest rule and the digest is printed and returned

R3.description: One JSON audit line per action, refusal and stop at $XDG_STATE_HOME/workflow-manager/retention-audit.jsonl, created 0600 in a 0700 directory, append-only, one write per line, outside the repository and the archive store, with the eleven fields; an unwritable audit file refuses before any action and a mid-run write failure stops the run

R4.description: --json prints the run as one retention_cleanup_run document with the existing exit-code conventions; the text output stays like the confirmed run
